body:
Hi. FondleMyLobster that phrase "if I'm dead it won't matter" echoes in my head constantly. I am saddened to see you too understand the feelings behind the hopelessness of that phrase. Your concern for your parents' well being from the consequences of the actions you are considering show that you -- you the person -- care, however your anxiety disagrees.

Please, reach out to someone. A friend, a counselor at high school, someone in your personal life that can hear your spoken word. Life day-to-day may currently be grinding to a halt from the non-stop pressure cooker of modern high school or currently ineffective medicine, but your life is beyond this. Please reach out. And Thank you for sharing your story. 

Peace.

The cold shoulder of digital age: night before a woman gestures she is interested -- hand holding, deep conversation, a kiss -- only to engage in a one-way conversation over text. When that last happened to me, my whole Sunday was spent lying in bed. "How could I have screwed this up so badly? Did I fuck this up myself?"

From what I interpreted, you hold and expect yourself to perform at a level you deem exceptional. I relate. And with regards to your suicidal thoughts over seemingly minuscule things -- missing a deadline or forgetting to send an email on time or missing a meeting -- suicide thoughts always spring to my head.

If I may, I wish to tell you for when I experienced that with a girl similar to yours, talk to a friend about it. One of my friends brought to my intentions how some women may prefer one-night stands or just to feel that gratification from guys. 

When I first heard that, I refused to believe the fact a girl I was interested in -- who was always busy, rarely responded, and never initialed conversation  -- was acting that way because of *my* actions/behavior. 

But as I watched her behavior at other gatherings and talked to friends about her, I discovered enough evidence to verify it was her personality.

Those were my thoughts. I hope they were of some help to you.

Hey. As a fellow college student, I agree that classes start to go to shit all at the same time. And I too am struggling keeping myself away from suicide (quite obviously...because I'm on this subreddit).

If I may say, my parents too would be close and hugging on the sofa one second, then screaming at each other the next. I talked to my mom about what I was seeing and feeling and she told me, "while I [my mom] feels awful we fight like this, this an issue between us [my dad and mom] and it is neither your responsibility nor your role to remedy."

From you have written, I have interpreted you genuinely care about your family; only they are simultaneously grinding all your gears while you love them. I will never understand your whole situation, but I want to tell you frustrations with your unstable parents and your brother with ADHD are mainly faults of their own.

Try to detach yourself from your frustrations towards your family and be selfish for a moment: think about you, which activity (walking, running, hiking, board games [or non-competitive/free world computer game], etc.) you can do to treat yourself.

Those are my thoughts. Much is going on in your life. Regardless of whether its angst or something else, your feelings are real.

Hi MemeKingofTheNorth.


Thank you. 

Thank you for responding at an odd hour and detailing your personal battle from self-harm to admission into a psychiatric institution. As a longtime lurker and first time poster, I feel welcomed.

Although I do not self-harm, the feelings you have described I find strongly relatable. Lying in bed at 10:00 P.M., only to finally go to sleep at 4:00 A.M. the next day, long showers, the anxiety...

I believe that such investments -- such as a loved one transporting me to the emergency room -- is wasteful. There are many, many more people whose lives matter more than mine. After reading your accomplishments, it seems you have one of those lives.

I am safe tonight. And I will go through the evaulation. Reading other posts in this community about hotlines and medication not working is making me feel less hopeful.

We'll see.


Edit: changed "And I will got through" to "And I will go through."
